method: Independent inspection of final delivery-size screenshots, separate from strict execution and browser findings. Minor notes do not waive missing facts, ambiguous relations, or broken contacts.

a-contract-1.notes: Two legible shared identities; direct horizontal object contacts and stable blue/red accents. Redundant context wording is minor.

a-naturalistic-1.notes: Three source-internal hub wires float short of Archive. The original audit missed this; the revised audit rejects gaps of 8.38, 8.37, and 5.82 displayed pixels.

a-naturalistic-2.notes: Required facts and all three row-to-collection identities are clear; internal hub contacts and shared colors hold. Generic labeled pictograms are not media-specific.

a-boundary-1.notes: Incoming line cleanly meets Source; dashed, labeled identity line is distinct. Source fills and outlines align; supplied text remains.

a-generalization-1.notes: All facts, ellipse enclosures, neutral Archive, and two undirected identity links remain legible. Long upper/right gutter routes are visually traceable but could be shorter.

b-contract-1.notes: Source and Review retain blue/red in both views; cross-view links touch their nodes. Containers remain traversable; text is readable.

b-naturalistic-1.notes: Unordered hub, aligned matrix, and spanning containment map preserve all facts and three identity links. No ambiguous replacement pictograms. Sparse right-hand lower space is a minor density limitation.

b-naturalistic-2.notes: Clean boundaries, stable palette, complete supplied facts and all identity links. Labeled generic pictograms beside Audio/Video are weak choices, but words preserve exact identity.

b-naturalistic-3.notes: Custom camera/audio/play symbols are recognizable with labels; all six links contact their intended surfaces. More explanatory prose and oversized upper padding than necessary, without hiding information.

b-boundary-1.notes: Repaired upstream contact and separate labeled identity bridge are visible; pale text and conflicting surfaces are repaired. Runtime still fails on external temporary-path reads.

b-boundary-2.notes: Clean imported Source objects with retained text, one named open upstream terminal, and one labeled identity bridge. An early failing final audit remains a strict execution failure.

b-generalization-1.notes: Two station/Archive relations in both lower views, actual ellipses, complete outputs, and no spurious arrows. Source facts and colors align; cross-view routes use visible gutters.

b-generalization-2.notes: Invented unlabeled circular ports inside the comparison rows make identity wires appear attached to the file-format cell and allow a wire through the row interior. Mechanical bindings pass but do not establish semantic ownership. The run also times out; it cannot support release.

b-generalization-3.notes: All ellipse and Archive contacts are visible and uncrossed. Color and repeated identities remain coherent. The long Optical identity route is less compact than ideal but unambiguous.

c-naturalistic-1.notes: Native measured panels give clean hub and identity contacts, consistent colors, all facts, fixed spans, readable text, and an honest labeled fallback without unrelated symbols.

c-naturalistic-2.notes: Stable colored cards and row swatches, actual node contacts, all facts and all requested identity links. Only Archive has a generic library symbol, supported by its visible name.

c-generalization-1.notes: The separate containment view need not repeat the two connectivity edges, so the initial eight-contact oracle was too prescriptive and was corrected. Independent visual review still fails: Archive detail labels crowd or spill beyond their small node enclosures, and the Radio identity route makes an unnecessarily long perimeter detour.

c-contract-1.notes: Two clear identities with stable colors, legible text, and direct boundary contacts. Extra lower-page white space is a minor compactness limitation.

c-naturalistic-3.notes: The connectivity caption touches/crosses the lower Video card, and Photos crowds its right boundary. Mechanical checks miss this source-internal caption placement; the final image is not accepted despite preserved facts and color bindings.

c-generalization-2.notes: Geometry and facts are clear, but the visible legend exposes technical hexadecimal color codes, contrary to the predeclared composition criterion. The outer identity routes are also much longer than necessary. Source-internal integrated edges are not covered by contact annotations and were checked visually.

c-generalization-3.notes: Complete facts, actual ellipse contacts, distinct undirected relations, and aligned colors. The added labeled Identity column duplicates station names and the perimeter routes are long, but ownership remains explicit and no information overlaps.

d-contract-1.notes: Clear Source/Review color alignment across views, two direct identity links touching the intended boundaries, and readable text. Some spare lower-page space remains.

d-naturalistic-1.notes: All media facts, spans, identity links, and six source-internal contacts are clear with stable blue/red/green. The labeled signpost/envelope/search pictograms are weak choices for Photos/Audio/Video; exact visible names prevent identity ambiguity, as in earlier accepted trials. The spanning enclosure leaves spare lower-right space.

d-boundary-1.notes: Both supplied Source views retain their text and now share a neutral fill and blue enclosure. The incoming line disappears at the Source boundary, the identity link touches both cards, and the shared reference text is legible.

d-generalization-1.notes: All observatory facts, requested ellipses, neutral Archive, and two distinct identity links are legible. The direct-view station relations are preserved without inventing a sequence. The large top matrix and longer Optical route leave room for further compactness, but no line overlaps text or an unrelated node.

d-naturalistic-2.notes: The label-only fallback is honest. Three hub wires meet the elliptical Archive, all collection colors and file/folder facts align across views, and all identity links meet their correct row/card surfaces without crossings. The lower-right spare space is a compactness limitation.

d-naturalistic-3.notes: All supplied facts and three cross-view identity links are clear, readable, and colored consistently. The signpost/envelope/search symbols are poor media metaphors, repeated more than necessary; exact Photos/Audio/Video labels retain meaning, so this is the same limited pass with icon-quality notes as naturalistic-1, not a claim of ideal pictogram selection.

d-generalization-3.notes: All facts, actual elliptical boundaries, shared colors, and both direct and integrated station-to-Archive relations are readable, with eight internal contacts. Two distinct identity routes avoid unrelated content. The Optical route is long, and the headline counts only the two lower representations while the page also includes a matrix; these editorial limitations do not obscure the labeled views or alter the supplied facts.

d-generalization-2.notes: Strict execution and mechanical geometry pass, but the integrated view adds directed arrowheads from both stations to Archive even though the supplied facts describe unordered connections, not a directional transfer. The very long Optical perimeter route also resembles a page boundary, and the headline sits too tightly against the canvas top. The trace additionally reads composition/test/router source while debugging; this is not a clean minimal production path. The artifact is retained as a manual/semantic failure, not accepted as a handoff example.
